theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  cases h₁ with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | red_I => cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb => exact ⟨_, hb, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _⟩
  | red_K => cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      let ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, hu, he ▸ .red_K ..⟩
  | red_S => cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      let ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb), he ▸ .red_S ..⟩
  | par ha hb => cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      let ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, he ▸ .red_K .., hu⟩
    | red_S =>
      let ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, he ▸ .red_S .., .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb)⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      let ⟨p, x, y⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      let ⟨q, u, v⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par x u, .par y v⟩

/-- The key result: the Church-Rosser property holds for `⭢ₚ`. The proof is a lengthy case analysis
on the reductions `a ⭢ₚ a₁` and `a ⭢ₚ a₂`, but is entirely mechanical.
-/
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction :=
  by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  cases h₁ with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | red_I =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb => exact ⟨_, hb, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _⟩
  |
